method: CPU samples actual standard glTF LINEAR quaternion animation channels and semantic-event times, then evaluates exported inverse-bind matrices plus JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 with linear-blend skinning. Renders are offline review evidence, not a Godot runtime claim.

semantic_events.name: locomotion_commit
semantic_events.meaning: Gameplay may transition into the run loop.

semantic_events.name: projectile_release
semantic_events.meaning: Spawn the basic-attack projectile at socket_projectile.

semantic_events.name: recovery_open
semantic_events.meaning: Basic attack can return to locomotion.

semantic_events.name: recovery_open
semantic_events.meaning: Alternate attack can return to locomotion.

semantic_events.name: projectile_release
semantic_events.meaning: Spawn the charged projectile at socket_projectile.

semantic_events.name: recovery_open
semantic_events.meaning: Charged attack can return to locomotion.

semantic_events.name: knockback_peak
semantic_events.meaning: Visual knockback peak; no root translation is authored.

semantic_events.name: stun_loop
semantic_events.meaning: Looping visual state; gameplay owns status duration.

semantic_events.name: death_complete
semantic_events.meaning: Animation is held; gameplay owns despawn timing.

semantic_events.name: dash_start
semantic_events.meaning: Gameplay begins Phase Step displacement; this clip has no root translation.

semantic_events.name: recovery_open
semantic_events.meaning: Phase Step can return to locomotion.

semantic_events.name: ultimate_charge
semantic_events.meaning: Apex Constellation gather reaches readable charge.

semantic_events.name: ultimate_impact_window
semantic_events.meaning: Open the final impact presentation window.
